headline: 1 year in, National Guard became a part of D.C. life. And, deadly quake hits Colombia
context: Today marks one year since the National Guard was deployed to the nation's capital. Here's what has happened since. And, a 7.4 magnitude earthquake leaves more than 100 people dead in Colombia.
